blind.description: An ornate architectural corbel or wall bracket floating in mid-air. It features a flat rectangular stone/metal top shelf resting on a tapered bracket adorned with a sculpted medieval sword and shield motif flanked by scrolling acanthus flourishes. Color scheme is silver/grey stone trim with rich navy blue panels. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and clean with no broken geometry or floating debris.
blind.from_above: A simple flat rectangular grey slab with sharp corners, casting a decorative bracket profile shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (roughly 40% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide across the top shelf.
